artworks.label: Lily picnic chair
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE new original standalone square1024x1024 Glaze small-widget illustration for froggy-picnic. One delightful miniature folding picnic chair with a broad soft sage-green lily-leaf seat and back, peach wooden crossed legs, one plump ivory daisy-shaped cushion and a little coral-and-cream gingham bow at the side. Premium kawaii handmade miniature, tactile soft felt/clay finish, rounded gentle forms, pale mint/sage/peach/ivory palette and soft warm light. No frog, duck, chick, teapot, sandwich, basket or parasol; chair is a wholly new picnic object. Entire compact subject centered with generous18percent empty margins, readable at small size. Truly transparent empty background, alpha preserved; no floor, opaque square, frame, panel or collage. Pure art: absolutely no lettering, text, numbers, dates, clocks, hands, dials, calendars, UI, logos or watermark. Never copy/crop/recolour existing art.
artworks.processing: Resize entire original square to 1024x1024; WebP q90 method4; alpha preserved; no crop, recolour or subject edits.
artworks.visualReview: Reviewed against wallpaper and all current pure-art subjects; distinct subject, matching style/palette, no text or live-value imagery.
